node.command: node --test tests/star-contrast.test.cjs tests/star-method-feasibility.test.cjs tests/star-recognition.test.cjs tests/star-geometry.test.cjs tests/star-native.test.cjs tests/star-fit-branches.cjs tests/star-fit-coverage.cjs

findings: retained missing-output distances as null rather than zero error
used single-path coverage and contamination in addition to aggregate coverage
kept wrong-but-unique axis candidates distinct from correct detection
kept reference geometry in evaluation phase only
retained all fixed conditions; no post-hoc parameter search
distinguished new photometric processing from unchanged downstream opening/component losses
limitations: two development photographs only, approximate prior centerlines
five approximate overlap ROIs, not an exhaustive grid-intersection annotation
numeric-scale accuracy lacks independent labels and unique axes were not recovered
no production integration, native browser replay or VLM comparison
fixed parameters do not exhaust contrast-normalization methods
